description:
**Dimension: ssot-duplication · 9 findings (8 medium, 1 low)** — see report §ssot-duplication.

Eliminate duplicated logic across the workspace. Highest code-quality leverage in the assessment.

Findings:
1. `gf2-coding/src/ldpc/nr_5g/mod.rs:753` — `compute_mother_encoding` has two literal copies of a 28-line pivot/swap/eliminate kernel; extract a private `rref_column_pass` helper and call twice.
2. `gf2-coding/src/drm.rs:624` — `DrmCode::systematic_form` reimplements Gaussian elimination; replace body with `gf2_core::alg::rref::rref(&g, false)`, keep only column rearrangement.
3. `gf2-coding/src/bch/core.rs:225` — `BchCode::lcm_poly` duplicates `gf2_core::field::charpoly::poly_lcm`; promote to `pub fn FieldPoly::lcm`, remove `lcm_poly`, have `poly_lcm` delegate.
4. `gf2-kernels-simd/src/bipedal/packed7.rs:37` — F_7 LUT builders duplicated verbatim with `gf2-algebra`; make `gf2-kernels-simd` the SSOT and import from `gf2-algebra`.
5. `gf2-sim/src/bin/*` — `mean_sigma` copy-pasted into 4 bin files; add `pub(crate) fn mean_sigma` to `gf2-sim/src/observability.rs` and replace copies (incl. inlined one in `parallel_throughput.rs`).
6. `gf2-kernels-hip/tests/common/mod.rs:18` — test helper re-declares raw HIP FFI; use `DeviceBuffer` RAII + `crate::ffi::hip_device_synchronize`.
7. `gf2-core/src/kernels/x86.rs` — unused detection stubs duplicate `gf2-kernels-simd::detect()` + 3 unimplemented TODO stubs; delete or delegate.
8. `gf2-algebra/src/packed/{packed5,packed7}.rs` — `Packed5Matrix`/`Packed7Matrix` omit `row()`/`to_row_major()`/`transpose()` that `Bipedal3Matrix` has (lib.rs:31 advertises all three); add them or document the asymmetry.
9. (low) `gf2-sim/src/bin/ldpc_bler_sweep.rs:177` — private `esn0_db_to_sigma` duplicates `channels::es_n0_db_to_sigma_f64`; remove local copy.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Findings 1-7 resolved: duplicated logic factored to a single source per the remediation; no remaining copy of each algorithm. Where a finding is a sanctioned performance/legacy exception, record the justification in this issue instead of deduping.
- [hard] REQ-02: Finding 8 resolved either by adding the three methods to both matrix types or by an explicit struct-doc note that the asymmetry is intentional.
- [hard] REQ-03: Finding 9 resolved (local copy removed).
- [hard] REQ-04: Full `cargo nextest --profile ci`, clippy `-D warnings`, fmt pass.
title: Eliminate SSOT duplication across the workspace
